title: 7 Things a Godly Man's Work Ethic Was Never Supposed to Prove
caption:
7 things a godly man's work ethic was never supposed to prove. Not one of them is on the timesheet.

His worth was decided at the cross, not the hours. He's not paying off a debt his father left behind. Deserving rest was never the entry fee for taking it. Comparison turns a calling into a scoreboard.

Busy is a good place to hide. Grace was never a wage he could earn. And his value was never up for a vote in the first place.
